Memphis Grizzlies — injuries
Stewart (knee) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game versus the Nuggets.
Stewart has played well in his first season in Memphis, averaging a career-high 11.9 points while shooting 57.1 percent from downtown. He has missed the last two games due to a bone bruise in his right knee. If Stewart remains sidelined Wednesday, GG Jackson and Taylor Hendricks are candidates for more minutes.
